entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, you made it. So, did you find[n]anything out?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you're tellin' me we're supposed[n]to be gettin' info from a homeless guy?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, I think I've seen one underground,[n]right near the construction area.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, [fName]. How are things going?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A homeless person? I haven't seen[n]any around here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There are a lot of people in this area.[n]Maybe he's somewhere else.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm counting on you, leader. I'll let you[n]know if I learn anything else.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: What's with that scary look on your face?[n]If you have something to say to me,[n]just say it.
I want a part-time job.
Are you in the mafia?

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: A part-time job?

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: You're not talking about some ordinary[n]job, huh? Take my advice: Don't do it.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: They'll squeeze every last penny out[n]of you with threats and extortion.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: Me? No, I'm just a lonely hermit.[n]What could you possibly want with[n]them anyway?

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: Don't go near them, you hear me?[n]They're horrible people.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: Some of my friends have fallen victim[n]to their schemes... That mafia is evil,[n]I tell you.
How do I meet them?
Your friends should run away.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: They'll come to you eventually if you[n]walk around this area around now.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: It's easy to say that, but none of them[n]have places to go... Just don't go[n]anywhere near that mafia.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: But just so you know who to avoid,[n]I'll teach you how to tell them apart[n]from normal people.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: They use some weird phrases.[n]Code words, you know.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: That's how they communicate with each[n]other. Anyway, watch out if you hear any[n]of that stuff.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: They'll try to come for you even during[n]the day. They're relentless when it comes[n]to targeting teens.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: I already told you what I know.[n]Do you need something else?
I want to thank you.
How can I identify them?

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: No need. You distracted me from my[n]ever-present boredom. That mafia's[n]been trouble for me too.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: Anyway, it's best you keep a low profile.[n]Life gets hard once they start noticing you.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: They speak in all sorts of weird,[n]uncommon phrases. Code, I'd say.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: They're very cautious though.[n]Even the police are having trouble[n]figuring them out.
